versions.changelog:
Initial release of mac-check-skill.

- Launches a full, local hardware and system check for Mac devices, covering device, system, battery, security, storage, network, and built-in peripheral tests.
- Operates strictly read-only, offline, and without requiring administrator privileges; never uploads data or connects to the internet.
- Generates detection reports in MD, PDF, and PNG formats for download.
- Designed for use cases including routine health checks, device acceptance, post-repair verification, pre-sale inspection, and troubleshooting.
- Offers both integrated Agent desktop host operation and terminal-based execution, with clear instructions for each.
- Ensures no system changes, no unofficial guarantees, and clear separation from Apple official diagnostics.
